punchline: The Nobel confirmed the formula was right; it did not confirm the fund would survive.
thirty_sec: On 14 October 1997 Scholes and Merton won the Nobel for a method of valuing derivatives; both had helped found LTCM, which lost 1.8 billion dollars in August 1998.
question: Which assumption of an expert you trust have you never tested under your own conditions?
key_contrast: The prize judged an idea; the fund's survival depended on debt and assumptions.
